description: This file defines a class ADODB2_sapdb extending ADODB_DataDict, implementing database-specific methods for SAP DB, including type mappings, SQL generation for altering tables, and column management.

classes.name: ADODB2_sapdb
classes.description: A class for SAP DB database dictionary operations, extending ADODB_DataDict with SAP DB-specific implementations.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps internal metadata codes to SAP DB data types.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Converts database column types to internal type codes.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffixes for column definitions based on attributes.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to add columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to modify existing columns.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop columns from a table.
